protocol.analysis_freeze: Protocol and source are frozen before the full parameter sweep. Small-population tests and selected analytic N64 anchors were examined during design. This is not external preregistration or evaluation on unseen held-out data.
protocol.claims: Per frozen instance unconditional coverage over sampling/detection randomness. Not conditional coverage among passed audits or simultaneous corpus coverage.
protocol.component_study: One-look audit with imperfect sensitivity, version1
protocol.defect_total_interpretation: K is the fixed number of stale claims before this final audit, in the64-claim post-repair pool. No12-inspection discovery phase is modeled.
independent_noise_assumptions: Independent Bernoulli detection on each sampled true defect
Known lower sensitivity q0 with actualq>=q0
Detected positives are correctly repaired locally; no other labels change
protocol.inference: Exact integer PMF sums and rational arithmetic over every feasible observed-positive count Y; no Monte Carlo.
limitations: No estimated sensitivity, specificity error or semantic model accuracy
No dependency drift, correlated noise guarantee or global business-loss guarantee
Misspecified/correlated scenarios deliberately violate calibrated independent assumptions
Known hypergeometric/binomial inversion; no statistical novelty claimed
protocol.pass_probability: Sum ALL feasibleY states satisfyingU(Y)-Y<=6; pass need not be monotone inY.
protocol.residual: K-Y includes false negatives inside the audited sample and missed defects outside it.
protocol.upper_bound: U(y)=max{K in[y,N]: P_q0(Y<=y)>delta}; residual bound U(y)-y. K upper search limit isN, notN-n+y.
